<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-030-important-20261029 -->
Implemented and verified; closing immediately after reviewing **all three original criteria**, authoritative-state/gesture source, actual fresh results and unchanged earlier acceptance methods.

[Immutable UIKit run40787364174](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40787364174) at `85d6d83b973bc36f0800ff231d6f97a16a3df08c` **SUCCESS**: **3/3** fresh genuine Compose/UIKit methods, one XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle **0/1632.85s**. All820 before/after inputs match their own Git revision; actual JDK17, iPhone iOS26.5/Xcode26.6, source/runtime/XML/protocol, distinct main/generated Worker completion and owned app cleanup reviewed.

- Delayed owner: proposed checked value does not become library-owned state. Measured thumb and authoritative Off semantics restore before acceptance; applying the delayed update moves exactly the20dp drag distance and On semantics, without another callback.
- Actual thumb and both track ends each propose once. Measured live preview crosses the threshold without changing owner/semantics; return then release emits no toggle and restores the measured thumb.
- Disabled tap/drag leave thumb, Disabled/On semantics and zero-callback state unchanged.
- Four unchanged original actual UIKit acceptance methods from40522929974 attempt2/20205909 cover null callback, accepting/rejecting owner and external checked/disabled update mid-gesture. Exact method bodies, four owning production files and catalog match; these successful methods were **reused, not replayed**. **3fresh+4reused=7 accepted executions.**

Repair separates transient drag preview from authoritative checked state, reconciles after every outcome and attaches full-control toggle semantics/gestures. Public APIs/packages/native names remain. [Evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/switch-ownership-important-20261028) preserves local KLIB-only results and prior failures. The reports-only offline review does not pretend to rerun the producer's absent executable/MachO/mtime checks; retained live bindings and independent XML/protocol/runtime/cleanup are explicitly distinguished.

Simulator pointer injection is not physical hardware, VoiceOver/Switch Control or older/minimum-OS/heap/profiling/ABI/consumer/dependency/legal/security/release certification. Those independent gates remain open. No package/release/deployment or unrelated full-suite replay.

<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-032-important-20261029 -->
Implemented and verified; closing directly after source/results review against **all three original numeric/layout acceptance criteria**.

[Immutable UIKit40790707874](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40790707874) at `887df6f0c18793cb040dbe43aa2739bc620a3ed8` **SUCCESS**: **2/2** new public LiquidGlassSlider methods, one fresh XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle **0/914.8s**. All822 before/after inputs match own Git revision; actual JDK17/iPhoneiOS26.5/Xcode26.6, native source/runtime/XML/protocol/distinct Worker completion and owned cleanup agree.

- Public0..0/initial9 controls clamp0 and remain inert under measured exact zero,1dp narrow and144dp unbounded fallback geometry in RTL; no nonfinite semantics/layout or false callbacks.
- Proven live pointer/press animation, range/width/RTL replacement and80 actual finite frame/layout/progress observations; one paired Cancel, no stale value/finish after replacement. Valid new-domain semantic request succeeds once; nonfinite requests are rejected.
- **14 unchanged relevant** prior actual Native/Compose methods (eight numeric-domain, six Damped animation) reused from40522929974 attempt2/20205909: constant/all-negative/extreme finite ranges, invalid/reversed/NaN/infinite inputs, clamped initial values, finite normalized progress/velocity/scales, input geometry, animation/cancellation ownership. Exact complete test files, six owning production files and catalog match. Two unrelated highlight methods remain preserved passing evidence but are **not counted** here; **2fresh+14reused=16 accepted executions**, not18 or a replayed121-case suite.

Repair validates finite ordered ranges, uses Double span intermediates, handles constant ranges without division, clamps values, normalizes Damped animations/velocity and bounds zero/narrow/unbounded layout. Public signatures/native names/packages remain. [Evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/slider-numeric-important-20261028) preserves KLIB-only/tooling results and prior failures. Reports-only offline review cannot recreate an absent executable/MachO/mtime; producer successful live checks and independent report bindings are explicitly distinguished.

These finite simulator/native observations are not universal hardware/profiling/sanitizer/minimum-platform/ABI/consumer/dependency/legal/security/release certification. Broader independent gates stay open; no packages/releases/deployment.
